name: Return to Jahan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.

Speak with me again when you are ready.  Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
narrative.objectives: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ahanu sent me finished products? Very good. There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively. I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

Thank you for all your efforts, adventurer. I am in your debt.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, you are back from Thunder Bluff? Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: A Bundle of Hides
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Return to Jahan
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
